ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5060 OC Edition 8GB GDDR6 Graphics Card

Step into the next generation of gaming fluidity and AI-accelerated workflows with the ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5060 OC Edition 8GB GDDR6 graphics card, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Built on NVIDIA's high-efficiency next-gen architecture, this powerful GPU features 8GB of high-speed GDDR6 memory layout to comfortably maximize frame rates at 1080p and 1440p resolutions. Optimized specifically for compact desktop builds and seamless mainstream integration, the Prime series utilizes dual ball fan bearings for maximum longevity and whisper-quiet cooling capacity. With factory overclocking tuned out of the box, it delivers premium gaming and rendering performance while maintaining exceptional power efficiency. This highly capable graphics setup is officially backed by a 3-year factory warranty.
